title: You Have to Let Go.
reviewNotes: Montage, captions and native complete later diagrams reviewed. Begin after Kf6/Rd5 at 164 seconds in the complete twelve-piece later diagram: White Kf6/d7/a4/g4/h3 against Kh6/Rd5/a6/b7/c6/h5/h7. Native52/53 establish the full board before promotion; native54 is the promotion menu, not extra pieces; native55 and58 confirm Qd8 and the source rook capture/pawn mate. d8=Q creates a mating attack while allowing the rook to capture the queen. The source Rxd8/g5# line and two independently supplied defenses are taught. A complete finite White strategy enumerates every Black defense, including rook checks and hxg4, through actual checkmates with all pawns retained; the guided lines are representative, not an exhaustive transcript. Earlier sacrifices, the larger initial setup and the entire Kf6 approach remain outside this selected proof.
